instances._review_comment: The platform layers are mounted whole, as smart-ra mounts them, so the site is built with the platform chrome. Other repositories' work plans are NOT reviewed through mounts: a mount is pinned to a commit, and beans live on a state branch outside that commit's tree, so a mount of dth-hrh or smart-ra arrived with no beans (measured 2026-10-20). beans-sources.json and scripts/pull-beans.ts read each beans branch live, and stay.
instances._site_comment: Built and published by an agent with cat-harness-tools/scripts/build-instance-site.ts, never by a workflow (owner, 2026-10-10, bean n3h9). `keep`: `ns`, the JSON-LD context publish-instance-context writes onto gh-pages.
instances._coverage_comment: `coverage: report`, not refuse: the cat-harness `beans` visualiser asks for one page per instance, and its state-viewer has no per-instance renderer for beans ("has no per-instance renderer", build log 2026-10-20), so a site that mounts layers holding beans can never satisfy it. The combined page en/cat-harness/beans/ is built. Return to refuse once the platform writes those pages.
